text: Which genes with enhanced ovary expression have no detectable mRNA in testis, and are expressed in only a handful of tissues?
plan: Tissue category (RNA): Ovary / Tissue enhanced AND Tissue category (RNA): Testis / Not detected AND Tissue category (RNA): any / Detected in some
understanding: The user is looking for genes that have enhanced RNA expression in ovary, have no detectable mRNA in testis, and have an RNA distribution restricted to only a handful of tissues (e.g., expressed in some tissues / limited tissue distribution) as classified under tissue RNA categories.

trail.why: Selecting 'ovary' at Level 1 and 'Tissue enhanced' at Level 2 filters for genes with at least four-fold higher mRNA levels in the ovary compared to the average level in all other tissues.
Selecting 'testis' at Level 1 and 'Not detected' at Level 2 identifies genes whose mRNA levels are below the detection cut-off of 1 nTPM specifically in the testis.

trail.requirement: expressed in only a handful of tissues
trail.why: The category 'Detected in some' matches being expressed in a small number of tissues (more than one but fewer than a third of the dataset), leaving Level 1 unrestricted to assess tissue distribution across all tissues.

requirements.why: The 'Tissue category (RNA)' field classifies genes by RNA specificity (including 'Tissue enhanced') per tissue (including 'ovary').
RNA expression and specificity per tissue (such as not detected in 'testis') is captured under 'Tissue category (RNA)'.

requirements.requirement: expressed in only a handful of tissues
requirements.why: RNA distribution across tissues (such as 'Expressed in some' or 'Expressed in low/limited tissues') is defined under 'Tissue category (RNA)'.
